items.weakness_text: The main weakness is the lack of immediate applicability to real problems. While the paper makes great progress on an extremely challenging problem, it remains unclear to me (and unsupported by the experiments) how useful the current implementation actually is. If the authors could provide a real-data application and show meaningful practical interpretation of the (accurately) learned equivalence class, I would change my mind about this.

As mentioned by the authors, the learning algorithm relies on solving the OICA problem, which, in general, is hard to solve with existing methods. That being said, the result of characterizing the equivalence class has a theoretical contribution regardless of the learning algorithm.

items.weakness_text: The evaluation mostly counts class sizes and compares to a MILP baseline for rank-realization under oracle ranks. There is no empirical test in the finite sample case.
